facts.algorithm: Sum of one-based character position multiplied by character value

title: Content reference URL checksums match a position-weighted character sum
statement: The stored checksum equals the sum of each character value multiplied by its one-based position in the stored URL text across the inspected native content-reference population. Studio integration fixtures were excluded. This is population evidence on one release, not a claim about every release or unobserved character encoding.

observations.observation: All 17243 native content references with non-null URL text matched the position-weighted character sum; zero mismatches. Studio portal integration fixtures were excluded. No row values are retained in the evidence report.
